kinematic_classification: Maximum of Fbar and Ftilde normalized max biases; descriptive, not fracture acceptance
force_scale: max(max physical N19 Frobenius(P)*h^2, max norm(b)*h^3); unchanged scale on N27
work_scale: F_ref * max(L,max norm(virtual displacement)); unit rigid translations use amplitude 1 m
continuum_gate_scale: P_ref L^2 for force; P_ref L^3 for moment; P_ref L^2 max(L,max norm(variation)) for work
moment_reference_identity: surface(X)+body(X)=integral sum_a e_a cross P_col_a; current-position resultant moment tested separately
N27_field: Same physical polynomial L=18h, same h and horizon; only specimen extent becomes 26h
constraint: Both z faces fixed to target; all other nodes free
field_bias_reference: Fbar at nodes; Ftilde at reference bond midpoint; nearest-face depth at the respective sample location
field_bias_RMS_weights: physical volume for Fbar; 2*wbar*Vi*Vj for Ftilde
Psi_plus_scale: max analytic Psi_plus over physical N19 nodes; same scale for both reconstruction types
channels: Diagonal vs off-diagonal of actual discrete bond Piola stress; force assembly linear at frozen geometry; no unique nonlocal face ownership
